title: The Influence of Corporate Income Taxes on Investment Location: Evidence from Corporate Headquarters Relocations
eligible_reason: Continuous, repeated treatment. The regressor tax_change01 is the percentage-point change in the headquarters state's corporate income tax rate in year t (hard-coded by state-year in CHKN_2020_code.do lines 33-97), split into positive (tax_change01p) and negative (tax_change01n) changes in later columns, with leads and lags in a distributed-lag specification. States change rates repeatedly and by different magnitudes, so there is no binary indicator switching on once at unit-specific dates. Main columns also include state-level and firm-level time-varying controls, and the inbound tests (Table 7) are destination-choice regressions with chosen10 as outcome.
design_notes: Firm-year panel 1994-2018 from 10-K header business addresses (Loughran-McDonald), outcome relocate10 = 1 if the business-address state differs next year. Specifications: reghdfe relocate10 tax_change01 [state controls firm controls], a(naics3 fyear) or a(naics3y) or a(cik fyear) or a(cik naics3y), cluster(ba_state_fips); sign-split tax_change01p/tax_change01n; leads/lags f2..l3; interactions with low sales-factor weight, combined/addback, multi-state operations. Inbound (Table 7): reghdfe chosen10 corptax_ch01p_duml1 corptax_ch01n_duml1 corptax_ch01p_duml2 corptax_ch01n_duml2 corptaxrate_omd/dest [controls] if origin_same_dest==0, a(fyear state_fips_origin) cluster(state_fips_origin). Sample flag esample87881 (87,881 firm-years).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Not applicable: continuous tax-rate changes occurring repeatedly across 1997-2017 in ~30 states.

specs.exclusion_reason: continuous treatment (percentage-point tax-rate change), repeated events; time-varying state and firm controls in main columns
specs.outcome: relocate10 (HQ moved out of state next year)
specs.treatment_var: tax_change01 (continuous; tax_change01p / tax_change01n in sign-split columns)
specs.fe: naics3 + fyear; naics3 x fyear (naics3y); cik + fyear; cik + naics3y
specs.controls: gsp_growth wsales_ch01 adjacent_tax_ch01 ... (state-level changes) and Compustat firm controls in main columns; none in the esample87881 columns
specs.notes: Line numbers vary by column; see regressions list.

data_files_note: Shipped: CHKN2020_sample_id_naics.dta (CIK/GVKEY/industry for sample firm-years), CHKN2020_sample_inbound_test.dta (Table 7 dataset), state_controls.dta, corptaxrate.dta, and the Stata log of main results. The firm-year outcome data must be rebuilt from the public Loughran-McDonald 10-K header file; firm controls require Compustat.
screener_notes: Tax-rate-change intensity design, not binary staggered adoption. Not eligible.
